> **note**: This rule has been implemented but not released yet. It will be available in the next release.

> **caution**: This rule is part of the [nursery](/linter/#nursery) group. This means that it is experimental and the behavior can change at any time.

## Summary
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/useConsistentHeadingLevel`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule doesn't have a fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**information**](/reference/diagnostics#information).
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`heading-increment`](https://github.com/DavidAnson/markdownlint/blob/main/doc/md001.md)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"useConsistentHeadingLevel": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Enforce that all heading levels are consistent and ordered.

In a Markdown document, the level of the headings should be consistent and grow only
by one level at a time.

This rule catches cases where a heading skips one or more levels.

## Examples

### Invalid

```md
# Header 1

### Header 3
```
